nodes.title: Shoe side load to failure
nodes.procedure: Two shoes as D5 builds them (R6: walls 1.2, rim 2.8, R 1.0 inside fillets, 25 mm engagement, layers along the sleeve axis) bonded on stepped foam-board offcuts (as T-D5-PROOF), insert pushed 4.5 mm in; load the pad sideways along +y on one, +z on the other, in 5 N steps to failure; record the load and where it cracks (rim, window end, roof, fin TE). Pass: failure load >= 1.5 x CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-LOAD (36.75 N at the D-105 cap) on both.
